items.title: Sacroiliac Joint Dysfunction and Associated Disability in the Immediate Postpartum Period: A Cross-Sectional Analysis for Clinical Screening and Rehabilitation
items.summary: A descriptive cross-sectional study in Sialkot, Pakistan, involving 300 postpartum women aged 20-40 years, found a high prevalence of sacroiliac joint pain and associated disability in the immediate postpartum period.
items.curatedReason: 本项横断面研究揭示了产后骶髂关节疼痛在巴基斯坦锡亚尔科特地区发病率较高，且与功能障碍存在关联。但鉴于其观察性设计，在指导临床实践时，仍需更高级别的证据来支持干预措施的有效性。
items.titleZh: 产后即刻骶髂关节功能障碍与相关残疾：一项临床筛查与康复的横断面分析
items.summaryZh: 一项在巴基斯坦锡亚尔科特对 300 名 20-40 岁产后女性进行的横断面研究发现，产后即刻骶髂关节疼痛患病率较高，且与功能障碍相关。
items.curatedReasonEn: This cross-sectional study reveals a high prevalence of postpartum sacroiliac joint pain and its association with disability in Sialkot, Pakistan. However, given its observational design, higher-level evidence is still needed to support the effectiveness of interventions in guiding clinical practice.
items.limitation: 本研究为横断面设计，无法推断因果关系，且数据来自单一地区，外推性有限。
items.limitationEn: This study's cross-sectional design prevents causal inference, and its single-region data limits generalizability.

items.title: Outcomes of rehabilitation following device-aided therapy start in parkinson's disease: a randomized controlled trial.
items.summary: An open-label randomized controlled trial with 45 completers found that adding 3 months of tailored primary care rehabilitation to device-aided therapy in Parkinson's disease patients resulted in better maintenance of patient motor skills at 6 and 12 months.
items.curatedReason: 这项 RCT 提示，对于帕金森病患者，在设备辅助治疗（DAT）基础上增加定制化初级康复能更好地维持运动技能。将康复早期整合到 DAT 路径中是值得考虑的。尽管样本量不算大，但运动技能的维持结果提供了重要的临床方向。
items.titleZh: 帕金森病设备辅助治疗启动后的康复结局：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项针对帕金森病患者的随机对照试验显示，在设备辅助治疗基础上增加 3 个月的定制化初级康复，能在 6 和 12 个月时更好地维持患者的运动技能。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT suggests that adding tailored primary care rehabilitation to device-aided therapy (DAT) in Parkinson's disease patients can better maintain motor skills. Integrating rehabilitation early into the DAT pathway is a worthwhile consideration. Although the sample size is moderate, the motor skill maintenance outcome provides an important clinical direction.
items.limitation: 研究样本量较小（45 名完成者），且部分次要结局未显示显著改善。
items.limitationEn: The study had a relatively small sample size (45 completers) and not all secondary outcomes showed significant improvement.

items.title: Association Between Danish Guideline Treatments for Breast Cancer and Physiotherapy-Relevant Late Effects: A Nationwide Cohort Study.
items.summary: A nationwide cohort study from Denmark found associations between specific guideline treatments for breast cancer and the risk of physiotherapy-relevant late effects, including shoulder impairment, lymphedema, and fatigue, 3-7 years postoperatively.
items.curatedReason: 这份丹麦全国性队列研究提示，特定的乳腺癌治疗方案与术后3-7年出现肩部功能障碍、淋巴水肿和疲劳等物理治疗相关晚期并发症的风险有关。这意味着在术后早期，你应密切关注那些接受了高风险治疗方案的患者，并考虑预防性干预。
items.titleZh: 丹麦乳腺癌指南治疗方案与物理治疗相关晚期并发症的关联：一项全国性队列研究
items.summaryZh: 一项丹麦全国性队列研究评估了乳腺癌指南治疗方案与术后 3-7 年物理治疗相关晚期并发症（如肩部功能障碍、淋巴水肿、疲劳）风险的关联。
items.curatedReasonEn: This Danish nationwide cohort study suggests specific breast cancer treatments are associated with a higher risk of late effects like shoulder impairment, lymphedema, and fatigue 3-7 years postoperatively. This implies you should closely monitor patients receiving these higher-risk treatments in the early post-op phase and consider proactive interventions.
items.limitation: 本研究为回顾性队列研究，且结局为患者自报，存在潜在混杂因素和回忆偏倚。
items.limitationEn: This retrospective cohort study used patient self-reported outcomes, introducing potential confounders and recall bias.
items.journal: Physiotherapy research international : the journal for researchers and clinicians in physical therapy

items.title: Pregnancy-Related Musculoskeletal Pain: Current Management, Influence on Biopsychosocial Health, and Patient-Reported Satisfaction With Care.
items.summary: An international internet survey of 671 women found that musculoskeletal pain is common during pregnancy, but physical therapy referral rates are unknown, and effective pain management correlates with higher satisfaction with prenatal care.
items.curatedReason: 孕期肌骨疼痛极其常见，这份国际调查显示，有效处理疼痛能显著提升孕妇对产前护理的满意度。尽管具体转诊物理治疗的数据仍缺失，这强烈提示我们应主动筛查孕妇疼痛并及时介入。
items.titleZh: 孕期肌骨疼痛：当前管理、对生物心理社会健康的影响及患者护理满意度报告
items.summaryZh: 一项对来自六大洲 671 名女性的国际线上调查显示，孕期肌骨疼痛普遍存在，但物理治疗转诊率不明，且有效的疼痛管理与产前护理满意度相关。
items.curatedReasonEn: Musculoskeletal pain is very common during pregnancy, and this international survey indicates that effective pain management significantly boosts satisfaction with prenatal care. While specific PT referral rates remain unknown, this strongly suggests we proactively screen pregnant patients for pain and intervene promptly.
items.limitation: 本研究为线上调查，存在回顾偏倚和自我报告偏差，且未评估具体干预效果。
items.limitationEn: This online survey is subject to recall and self-report biases and did not evaluate the efficacy of specific interventions.

items.title: Accelerated Return to Competition Following a Full-Thickness Abdominal Wall Tear in an Elite Sprinter: A Data-informed Case Report.
items.summary: A case report describes the rehabilitation and accelerated return-to-competition process for a 22-year-old elite international sprinter who sustained a full-thickness tear of the external, internal, and transversus abdominis muscles.
items.curatedReason: 这是一个关于精英短跑运动员腹壁全层撕裂的个案报道，描述了其加速重返赛场的康复过程。这为你处理罕见运动损伤和制定高水平运动员重返赛场策略提供了个案经验，但由于是单一个案，不应直接泛化为临床指南。
items.titleZh: 精英短跑运动员腹壁全层撕裂后加速重返赛场的案例报告：数据支持
items.summaryZh: 一份案例报告描述了一名 22 岁精英国际短跑运动员在腹外斜肌、腹内斜肌和腹横肌全层撕裂后，通过康复训练加速重返赛场的详细过程。
items.curatedReasonEn: This case report details the accelerated return-to-competition of an elite sprinter with a full-thickness abdominal wall tear. While offering insights into rare sports injuries and high-level return-to-sport strategies, its single-case nature prevents direct generalization to clinical guidelines.
items.limitation: 本研究为单一个案报告，外推性差，不代表普遍情况或可复制的干预效果。
items.limitationEn: This is a single case report with limited generalizability, not representative of common outcomes or reproducible intervention effects.
items.journal: International journal of sports physical therapy

items.title: Telerehabilitation before and after lumbar spine surgery: A scoping review.
items.summary: A scoping review mapped existing evidence on telerehabilitation interventions for patients undergoing lumbar spine surgery, highlighting intervention characteristics and identifying evidence gaps due to a lack of standardized protocols.
items.curatedReason: 目前，腰椎术后远程康复尚无标准化方案。这份范围综述虽梳理了现有干预模式，但更多是揭示了该领域的证据空白，别指望能直接从中提取成熟的临床路径。
items.titleZh: 腰椎术前术后的远程康复：一项范围综述
items.summaryZh: 一项范围综述系统梳理了腰椎手术患者远程康复干预的现有证据，重点关注干预特征，并指出现有研究在标准化方案上的空白。
items.curatedReasonEn: Standardized protocols for telerehabilitation in lumbar spine surgery are still missing. While this scoping review maps existing interventions, it primarily highlights current evidence gaps; don't expect to find ready-to-implement clinical pathways here.
items.limitation: 本综述识别了研究空白，但未对现有干预的有效性进行系统评价或荟萃分析。
items.limitationEn: This review identified research gaps but did not systematically evaluate or meta-analyze the effectiveness of existing interventions.
items.journal: PM & R : the journal of injury, function, and rehabilitation

items.title: Preliminary effects of myofascial release on chest mobility and trunk impairmentin patients with chronic stroke: a pilotRandomized controlled trial.
items.summary: A pilot RCT (n=20) investigated the preliminary effects of myofascial release (MFR) on chest mobility and trunk impairment in chronic stroke patients, comparing MFR plus inspiratory muscle training (IMT) to chest stretching, diaphragmatic breathing, and IMT over 8 weeks.
items.curatedReason: 筋膜松弛术在慢性卒中患者胸部活动度和躯干功能障碍上的初步效果是积极的。这是个小样本试点研究，提示了潜在的增益，但在常规应用前还需等待大规模 RCT 验证。
items.titleZh: 筋膜松弛术对慢性卒中患者胸部活动度和躯干功能障碍的初步效果：一项随机对照试点研究
items.summaryZh: 一项纳入 20 名慢性卒中患者的试点 RCT 显示，筋膜松弛术（MFR）联合呼吸肌训练（IMT）与传统胸部牵伸、膈式呼吸及 IMT 相比，在改善胸部活动度和躯干功能障碍方面可能具有积极效果。
items.curatedReasonEn: Myofascial release shows positive preliminary effects on chest mobility and trunk impairment in chronic stroke patients. This small pilot study suggests potential benefits, but larger RCTs are needed before routine clinical application.
items.limitation: 本研究为小样本试点 RCT (n=20)，结果外推性有限。
items.limitationEn: This was a small pilot RCT (n=20), limiting the generalizability of its findings.

items.title: Managing Patients With Hypermobility Disorders: They've Seen You, but Have You Seen Them?
items.summary: This editorial highlights the challenges physical therapists face in managing hypermobility spectrum disorders (HSD) and hypermobile Ehlers-Danlos syndrome (hEDS), proposing a structured approach to care amidst limited high-quality randomized trials but emerging consensus.
items.curatedReason: 针对超活动度障碍（HSD/hEDS）患者，这份述评提供了实用的管理框架。在 RCT 证据有限的情况下，它能帮助你系统化评估，避免碎片化治疗。
items.titleZh: 管理超活动度障碍患者：你了解他们，他们也需要被你理解吗？
items.summaryZh: 针对物理治疗师在管理超活动度障碍（HSD）和超活动性埃勒斯-丹洛斯综合征（hEDS）患者时面临的挑战，本述评提出了一种结构化的治疗方法，以应对高质量随机试验有限但共识不断涌现的局面。
items.curatedReasonEn: With high-quality RCT evidence for hypermobility spectrum disorders (HSD/hEDS) still largely absent, this editorial offers a practical management framework. Use it to structure your approach and avoid fragmented care, but recognize it reflects expert consensus, not strong evidence.
items.journal: The Journal of orthopaedic and sports physical therapy

items.title: External validation of the minimal important change in the Berg Balance Scale scores of patients hospitalized for subacute stroke.
items.summary: This longitudinal study externally validated minimal important change (MIC) values for the Berg Balance Scale (BBS) in 286 patients hospitalized for subacute stroke, assessing 2-, 5-, and 9-point thresholds in overall and walking-ability subgroups.
items.curatedReason: 这份研究外部验证了亚急性卒中患者 Berg 平衡量表（BBS）的最小重要变化（MIC）值，尤其细分了步行能力亚组。这能让你更精准地解读 BBS 评分变化，评估患者的功能改善。
items.titleZh: 住院亚急性卒中患者 Berg 平衡量表评分最小重要变化值的外部验证
items.summaryZh: 这项纵向研究对286名住院亚急性卒中患者的 Berg 平衡量表（BBS）评分的最小重要变化（MIC）值进行了外部验证，评估了在整体队列和步行能力亚组中 ≥2、≥5 和 ≥9 分的阈值。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study externally validates the minimal important change (MIC) values for the Berg Balance Scale (BBS) in subacute stroke patients, with subgroups based on walking ability. This allows you to interpret BBS score changes more precisely and assess functional improvement.
items.limitation: 本研究为观察性设计，仅在特定康复单元进行，可能存在选择偏倚和外推性限制。
items.limitationEn: This study has an observational design and was conducted in a specific rehabilitation unit, which may introduce selection bias and limit generalizability.
items.journal: Archives of physical medicine and rehabilitation

items.title: External Validation of a Machine Learning Model for the Early Prediction of Upper-Limb Recovery After Stroke.
items.summary: This study externally validated a machine learning model for predicting 6-month upper-limb capacity after stroke (ARAT scores) using an independent Danish prospective cohort, following development on a multicenter Dutch cohort of first-ever ischemic stroke patients.
items.curatedReason: 这个模型在独立丹麦队列中的外部验证，意味着其对卒中后6个月上肢功能的预测能力具备初步的泛化性。我们离利用机器学习辅助临床决策又近了一步，但请注意，在常规临床应用前仍需更多高质量验证。
items.titleZh: 中风后上肢恢复早期预测机器学习模型的外部验证
items.summaryZh: 本研究外部验证了一个机器学习模型，该模型用于预测中风后 6 个月上肢能力（通过 ARAT 评分衡量），验证队列为一个独立的丹麦前瞻性队列，此前该模型在荷兰的多中心首次缺血性中风患者队列中开发。
items.curatedReasonEn: This model's external validation in an independent Danish cohort suggests its predictive ability for 6-month upper-limb function post-stroke has initial generalizability. We're closer to leveraging machine learning for clinical decision support, but remember, more high-quality validation is needed before routine clinical adoption.
items.limitation: 验证队列包含了缺血性和出血性中风患者，但模型是在荷兰的首次缺血性中风队列中开发的，可能影响对其他类型中风的泛化能力。
items.limitationEn: The validation cohort included both ischemic and hemorrhagic stroke patients, but the model was developed in a Dutch cohort of first-ever ischemic strokes, which might affect generalizability to other stroke types.

items.title: Moving Forward Together. Part 6: Transforming Musculoskeletal Health Physical Therapy for Indigenous Peoples-A Call to Action.
items.summary: This call to action encourages musculoskeletal physical therapists, organizations, and systems to engage in multisector efforts to improve care and outcomes for Indigenous Peoples in clinical practice, research, and education.
items.curatedReason: 这份评论呼吁物理治疗师在临床、研究和教育中关注原住民的骨骼肌肉健康，并作为盟友和倡导者发挥作用。这是建立更具包容性和公平的物理治疗实践的重要一步，值得思考和借鉴。
items.titleZh: 携手前行。第六部分：为原住民群体改革肌肉骨骼健康物理治疗——一项行动呼吁
items.summaryZh: 这项行动呼吁鼓励肌肉骨骼物理治疗师、组织和系统参与多部门合作，以改善原住民群体的临床实践、研究和教育中的护理和结局。
items.curatedReasonEn: This commentary calls on physical therapists to prioritize Indigenous musculoskeletal health in clinical practice, research, and education, acting as allies and advocates. It's a crucial step towards more inclusive and equitable physical therapy practices, warranting reflection and adoption.
items.journal: The Journal of orthopaedic and sports physical therapy

items.title: Effectiveness of an AI-based home exercise app for rehabilitation of rotator cuff-related shoulder pain: A randomized controlled trial.
items.summary: A single-center RCT (N=46) found that adding an AI-based digital rehabilitation program with real-time computer vision feedback to standard physiotherapy significantly improved pain and function in adults with rotator cuff-related shoulder pain over 12 weeks.
items.curatedReason: AI 辅助的家庭康复应用能有效提升肩袖相关肩痛患者的治疗效果。这项 RCT 表明，在常规物理治疗基础上增加带实时反馈的 AI 应用，患者疼痛和功能改善更显著。这证实了数字工具在提高依从性和疗效方面的潜力。
items.titleZh: 人工智能家庭运动应用在肩袖相关肩痛康复中的疗效：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项单中心随机对照试验（N=46）发现，在常规物理治疗基础上，增加一个基于人工智能并提供实时计算机视觉反馈的数字康复项目，在 12 周内显著改善了肩袖相关肩痛患者的疼痛和功能。
items.curatedReasonEn: AI-powered home exercise apps can effectively enhance treatment outcomes for patients with rotator cuff-related shoulder pain. This RCT shows that adding an AI app with real-time feedback to standard physiotherapy leads to more significant improvements in pain and function, confirming the potential of digital tools to boost adherence and efficacy.
items.limitation: 这是一项单中心研究，样本量较小（N=46），结果的普适性可能受限。
items.limitationEn: This was a single-center study with a relatively small sample size (N=46), which may limit the generalizability of the results.

items.title: Additive Effects of Repetitive Transcranial Magnetic Stimulation and Transcranial Direct Current Stimulation on Robotic Therapy for Upper Extremity Recovery After Chronic Ischemic Stroke: A Randomized, Double-Blind, Sham-Controlled Trial.
items.summary: A randomized, double-blind, sham-controlled trial (N=36) in chronic ischemic stroke patients found that adding repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation (rTMS) or transcranial direct current stimulation (tDCS) to robotic therapy did not provide additional benefits for upper extremity motor and functional recovery.
items.curatedReason: 这项 RCT 发现，在慢性缺血性卒中患者上肢康复中，经颅磁刺激（rTMS）或经颅直流电刺激（tDCS）结合机器人疗法并未显示出额外的显著益处。这意味着对于这类患者，单纯的机器人疗法可能已经足够，没必要盲目叠加脑刺激技术。
items.titleZh: 重复经颅磁刺激和经颅直流电刺激对慢性缺血性卒中后上肢机器人康复的附加效应：一项随机、双盲、假对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 36 例慢性缺血性卒中上肢障碍患者的随机、双盲、假对照试验发现，在机器人治疗基础上增加重复经颅磁刺激（rTMS）或经颅直流电刺激（tDCS），并未对上肢运动和功能恢复带来额外益处。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT found that adding rTMS or tDCS to robotic therapy did not provide significant additional benefits for upper extremity recovery in chronic ischemic stroke patients. This suggests that robotic therapy alone might be sufficient for these patients, without the need to indiscriminately combine brain stimulation techniques.
items.limitation: 研究样本量较小（N=36），且是单中心试验，结果需更多大规模研究验证。
items.limitationEn: The study had a small sample size (N=36) and was a single-center trial, so results require validation from larger studies.
items.journal: Archives of physical medicine and rehabilitation

items.title: Remotely Monitored Home-based Pulmonary Rehabilitation in Idiopathic Pulmonary Fibrosis: Results of a Randomized Controlled Trial.
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial (N=29) in patients with idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis (IPF) on antifibrotic therapy demonstrated that a 12-week asynchronously remotely monitored, exercise-focused home pulmonary rehabilitation program was feasible and effective.
items.curatedReason: 对于正在接受抗纤维化治疗的特发性肺纤维化（IPF）患者，为期 12 周的异步远程监测居家运动康复是可行且有效的。这意味着，如果患者难以定期到院，远程康复是值得推进的替代方案。
items.titleZh: 特发性肺纤维化患者的远程监测居家肺康复：一项随机对照试验结果
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 29 例接受抗纤维化治疗的特发性肺纤维化（IPF）患者的随机对照试验表明，为期 12 周的异步远程监测居家肺康复方案是可行且有效的。
items.curatedReasonEn: For patients with idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis (IPF) on antifibrotic therapy, a 12-week asynchronously remotely monitored, exercise-focused home pulmonary rehabilitation program is feasible and effective. If patients struggle with regular in-clinic visits, remote rehab is a viable alternative worth pursuing.
items.limitation: 样本量较小（29 例随机患者），可能会限制结果的统计效力和外推性。
items.limitationEn: The sample size was relatively small (29 randomized patients), which may limit the statistical power and generalizability of the results.
items.journal: Archives of physical medicine and rehabilitation

items.title: Exercise prescription: Physiotherapy's most important and least standardized skill.
items.summary: This commentary highlights that while exercise is a ubiquitous recommendation in musculoskeletal physiotherapy, there is a lack of confidence, consistency, and clarity in how prescription decisions are made and communicated. It advocates for emphasizing longitudinal reasoning linking patient assessment to prescription and modification.
items.curatedReason: 运动处方是 PT 最核心的技能，但目前缺乏标准化语言和系统性方法论。这篇文章提醒你，与其关注处方表开了什么，不如深挖评估、进展和调整的纵向推理，这才是提升临床实践的关键。
items.titleZh: 运动处方：物理治疗最重要的、但标准化程度最低的技能
items.summaryZh: 这篇述评指出，运动处方在骨骼肌肉物理治疗中普遍存在，但处方决策和沟通的信心、一致性和清晰度有限。文章强调应侧重于将患者评估与处方、进展和修改联系起来的纵向推理，而非仅仅关注处方输出。
items.curatedReasonEn: Exercise prescription is a core PT skill, yet it lacks standardized language and systematic methodology. This article reminds you that focusing on longitudinal reasoning from assessment to progression and modification, rather than just the prescription outputs, is key to enhancing clinical practice.
items.limitation: 这是一篇述评，不涉及实证研究设计。
items.limitationEn: This is a commentary and does not involve empirical research design.

items.title: One-year Health Care Utilization Following Physical Therapist Evaluation in a Veterans Affairs Emergency Department.
items.summary: A retrospective cohort study found that physical therapist evaluation in a Veterans Affairs Emergency Department for musculoskeletal pain was associated with decreased healthcare utilization within the ED, but showed no significant association with overall 1-year musculoskeletal healthcare utilization.
items.curatedReason: 急诊物理治疗师（EDPT）介入后，退伍军人因肌肉骨骼疼痛的医疗利用率在 ED 内有所下降，但一年内的整体医疗利用率差异不显著。这提示 EDPT 仍能优化急诊流程，但要降低长期总利用率，可能还需要更全面的多学科策略。
items.titleZh: 退伍军人事务部急诊科物理治疗师评估后一年内的医疗利用情况
items.summaryZh: 一项回顾性队列研究显示，退伍军人事务部急诊科对肌肉骨骼疼痛患者进行物理治疗师评估后，急诊科内部的医疗利用率有所下降，但与一年内整体肌肉骨骼医疗利用率无显著关联。
items.curatedReasonEn: After Emergency Department Physical Therapist (EDPT) intervention, healthcare utilization for musculoskeletal pain decreased within the ED for veterans, but no significant difference was observed in overall 1-year healthcare utilization. This suggests EDPTs can optimize ED processes, but reducing long-term total utilization may require more comprehensive, multidisciplinary strategies.
items.limitation: 这是一项回顾性队列研究，且仅限于单一退伍军人健康管理局急诊科，结果的外推性受限。
items.limitationEn: This was a retrospective cohort study conducted at a single Veterans Health Administration ED, limiting the generalizability of the results.

items.title: Characteristics and Specific Aspects of the Therapeutic Alliance in Physiotherapy Care: A Qualitative Study in France.
items.summary: A qualitative study in France identified characteristics and specific aspects of the therapeutic alliance in physiotherapy care, highlighting unique relational dynamics created by the use of touch and physical activity.
items.curatedReason: 这项法国的定性研究揭示了物理治疗中治疗联盟的特点，强调了触诊和身体活动如何创造独特的治疗关系。这提醒你，治疗联盟在 PT 中不止是心理层面的互动，更包含了身体接触和共同运动所塑造的深层连接，理解这些特质能帮你更好地建立和维护患者关系。
items.titleZh: 物理治疗中治疗联盟的特征和特殊方面：一项法国的定性研究
items.summaryZh: 一项法国的定性研究识别了物理治疗中治疗联盟的特征和具体方面，强调了通过触诊和身体活动创造的独特关系动态。
items.curatedReasonEn: This qualitative study from France reveals the characteristics of the therapeutic alliance in physiotherapy, emphasizing how touch and physical activity create unique therapeutic relationships. It reminds you that the therapeutic alliance in PT involves more than just psychological interactions; it also encompasses deep connections shaped by physical contact and shared movement. Understanding these characteristics can help you better establish and maintain patient relationships.
items.limitation: 这是一项定性研究，样本量较小，且研究背景仅限于法国，结果不宜直接外推。
items.limitationEn: This is a qualitative study with a small sample size, conducted solely in France, so the results should not be directly generalized.
items.journal: Physiotherapy research international : the journal for researchers and clinicians in physical therapy

items.title: Acute Effects of Varying Neuromuscular Electrical Stimulation Amplitude on Quadriceps Isometric Torque and Muscle Thickness in Healthy Young Adults: A Randomized Split-Limb Trial.
items.summary: A randomized split-limb trial in healthy young adults (N unspecified) found that increasing self-reported tolerated neuromuscular electrical stimulation (NMES) amplitude did not enhance acute quadriceps isometric torque or muscle thickness.
items.curatedReason: 关于神经肌肉电刺激（NMES）剂量学，该研究发现，在健康年轻人中，自报可耐受振幅的增加并不能显著增强急性股四头肌等长扭矩或肌肉厚度。这意味着高强度并非总是带来更优的急性生理反应，为临床设定 NMES 参数提供了更精细的考量。
items.titleZh: 健康年轻人中不同神经肌肉电刺激振幅对股四头肌等长扭矩和肌肉厚度的急性影响：一项随机分肢试验
items.summaryZh: 一项针对健康年轻人的随机分肢试验发现，增加自报可耐受的神经肌肉电刺激（NMES）振幅，并未能增强股四头肌的急性等长扭矩和肌肉厚度。
items.curatedReasonEn: Regarding neuromuscular electrical stimulation (NMES) dosimetry, this study found that increasing self-reported tolerated amplitude did not significantly enhance acute quadriceps isometric torque or muscle thickness in healthy young adults. This suggests that higher intensity does not always yield superior acute physiological responses, offering a more nuanced consideration for clinical NMES parameter setting.
items.limitation: 研究对象为健康年轻人，结果外推到临床患者群体时需谨慎。
items.limitationEn: The study involved healthy young adults; results should be applied cautiously when extrapolating to clinical patient populations.
items.journal: Physiotherapy research international : the journal for researchers and clinicians in physical therapy

items.title: Weight Bearing Decisions After Tibial Plateau Fractures: A Literature Review Based on Clinical Perspective for Physiotherapists in India.
items.summary: This literature review provides a clinical perspective for physiotherapists in India on weight-bearing decisions after tibial plateau fractures, aiming to address the lack of India-specific guidance that accounts for local clinical realities.
items.curatedReason: 这篇综述为印度背景下的胫骨平台骨折患者提供了基于临床视角的负重决策框架。由于印度特定的医疗条件和植入物质量，这份指南填补了高收入国家协议无法直接套用的空白。你可以参考这种思路，在缺乏本地指南时，如何基于现有证据和具体实践情境制定方案。
items.titleZh: 胫骨平台骨折后负重决策：基于印度物理治疗师临床视角的文献综述
items.summaryZh: 这篇文献综述从临床角度为印度物理治疗师提供了胫骨平台骨折后的负重决策指南，旨在弥补缺乏考虑当地临床实际情况的印度特有指导的空白。
items.curatedReasonEn: This review offers a clinically-oriented weight-bearing decision framework for tibial plateau fracture patients in the Indian context. Given India's specific healthcare conditions and implant quality, this guidance fills a gap where high-income country protocols are not directly applicable. You can refer to this approach for developing guidelines in contexts lacking local protocols, based on existing evidence and specific practice realities.
items.limitation: 这是一篇文献综述，而非实证研究，且侧重于印度特定临床背景。
items.limitationEn: This is a literature review, not empirical research, and focuses on a specific Indian clinical context.
items.journal: Physiotherapy research international : the journal for researchers and clinicians in physical therapy

items.title: Clinical practice guideline for physical therapist management of total knee arthroplasty: revision 2026.
items.summary: The American Physical Therapy Association has released a 2026 revision of its clinical practice guideline for physical therapist management of total knee arthroplasty, updating the 2020 version based on a systematic review of current literature and formulating 20 recommendations.
items.curatedReason: PTA 发布了全膝关节置换（TKA）物理治疗管理指南的 2026 年修订版，这是一线指南。立即查阅并将其整合进你的 TKA 术后康复方案中。
items.titleZh: 全膝关节置换物理治疗管理临床实践指南：2026 年修订版
items.summaryZh: 美国物理治疗协会发布了其全膝关节置换（TKA）物理治疗管理临床实践指南的 2026 年修订版，该指南基于系统综述更新了 2020 年版本，并提出了 20 条建议。
items.curatedReasonEn: The APTA has released its 2026 revision of the clinical practice guideline for physical therapist management of total knee arthroplasty (TKA). This is a front-line guideline. Review it immediately and integrate its recommendations into your TKA post-op rehabilitation protocols.

items.title: Repetitive Transcranial Magnetic Stimulation for Dizziness, Balance, and Postural Stability in Adult Patients With Chronic Peripheral Vestibular Dizziness.
items.summary: A double-blind RCT of 56 adults with chronic vestibular dizziness found that 8 weeks of repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation (rTMS) combined with vestibular rehabilitation (VR) significantly improved dizziness, balance, and postural stability compared to sham rTMS plus VR.
items.curatedReason: 对于慢性前庭性眩晕，rTMS 结合前庭康复（VR）显示出显著的改善效果。如果你的诊所有 rTMS 设备，可以作为慢性前庭功能障碍患者的增效治疗手段。
items.titleZh: 重复经颅磁刺激治疗成人慢性前庭性眩晕的眩晕、平衡和姿势稳定性：一项双盲随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 56 名慢性前庭性眩晕成年患者的双盲随机对照试验显示，为期 8 周的重复经颅磁刺激（rTMS）结合前庭康复（VR）显著改善了眩晕、平衡和姿势稳定性，优于假 rTMS 结合 VR。
items.curatedReasonEn: For chronic peripheral vestibular dizziness, rTMS combined with vestibular rehabilitation (VR) shows significant improvement. If your clinic has rTMS equipment, consider it as an augmentative treatment for patients with chronic vestibular dysfunction.
items.limitation: 研究未详细说明随机分组的详细过程及偏倚风险。
items.limitationEn: The study did not elaborate on the detailed randomization process and potential bias risks.
items.journal: Archives of physical medicine and rehabilitation

items.title: Effects of a Virtual Reality-Based Balance Training Program on Clinical Outcomes and Cortical Oscillatory Activity: A Combined Behavioral and EEG Study.
items.summary: A single-group repeated-measures study of 28 subacute stroke survivors found that 12 sessions of VR-based balance training over 4 weeks improved clinical mobility outcomes, including Berg Balance Scale and Timed Up and Go scores.
items.curatedReason: 短期的 VR 平衡训练似乎能在卒中亚急性期患者中改善平衡和运动功能。可以考虑将其作为常规康复的补充手段。
items.titleZh: 虚拟现实平衡训练对卒中患者临床结局和皮层振荡活动的影响：一项行为与脑电图结合研究
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 28 名亚急性期卒中幸存者的单组重复测量研究显示，为期 4 周的 12 次虚拟现实平衡训练课程改善了伯格平衡量表（BBS）和计时起立行走（TUG）测试等临床运动结局。
items.curatedReasonEn: Short-term VR balance training appears to improve balance and motor function in subacute stroke survivors. Consider integrating it as a supplemental intervention in your rehabilitation programs.
items.limitation: 本研究为前瞻性单组重复测量研究，缺乏对照组，无法排除安慰剂效应或自然恢复。
items.limitationEn: This was a prospective single-group repeated-measures study without a control group, so it cannot rule out placebo effects or natural recovery.

items.title: Influence of knee hyperextension persisting into preswing on swing-phase kinematics through forward propulsion in poststroke hemiparetic gait.
items.summary: A study of 30 chronic poststroke hemiparetic patients found that knee hyperextension persisting into preswing was associated with reduced forward propulsion and altered swing-phase kinematics, including functional limb shortening and peak knee-flexion angle.
items.curatedReason: 该观察研究揭示了卒中偏瘫步态中膝关节过伸对摆动相运动学的影响。这有助于你更精细地评估和干预卒中患者的步态问题。
items.titleZh: 卒中后偏瘫步态中，摆动前期持续存在的膝关节过伸对通过前向推进的摆动期运动学的影响
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 30 名慢性卒中后偏瘫患者的研究发现，摆动前期持续存在的膝关节过伸与前向推进力降低以及摆动期运动学改变相关，包括功能性肢体缩短和膝关节屈曲峰值角度。
items.curatedReasonEn: This observational study reveals the influence of knee hyperextension on swing-phase kinematics in post-stroke hemiparetic gait. This can help you refine your assessment and intervention for gait issues in stroke patients.
items.limitation: 本研究为横断面观察研究，无法建立因果关系，且样本量较小。
items.limitationEn: This was a cross-sectional observational study, unable to establish causality, and had a small sample size.

items.title: Evaluating the impact of high dose inpatient rehabilitation gait training on post stroke physical activity: A secondary analysis of a randomized controlled trial.
items.summary: A secondary analysis of an RCT on 140 subacute stroke patients found that higher doses of inpatient step training did not significantly affect physical activity levels 12 months post-stroke, nor did walking improvements during rehabilitation predict 12-month physical activity.
items.curatedReason: 这项针对卒中康复的二次分析显示，住院期间高剂量步态训练与出院 12 个月后的身体活动水平无关。这提示我们需要重新思考如何在住院期后维持和提高卒中患者的长期活动量。
items.titleZh: 评估住院康复高剂量步态训练对卒中后身体活动的影响：一项随机对照试验的二次分析
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 140 名亚急性卒中患者的随机对照试验二次分析发现，住院期间更高剂量的步态训练并未显著影响卒中后 12 个月的身体活动水平，住院康复期间的步行改善也未能预测 12 个月的身体活动。
items.curatedReasonEn: This secondary analysis of stroke rehabilitation indicates that higher doses of inpatient gait training were not associated with physical activity levels 12 months post-stroke. This suggests a need to rethink how we maintain and improve long-term activity levels for stroke patients after discharge.
items.limitation: 本研究为随机对照试验的二次分析，可能存在原始研究未报告的混杂因素，且未直接评估高剂量训练与身体活动的关系。
items.limitationEn: This is a secondary analysis of an RCT, potentially subject to unconfounded factors not reported in the original study, and did not directly assess the relationship between high-dose training and physical activity.
items.journal: Archives of physical medicine and rehabilitation

items.title: Sex- and age-specific risk factors for possible sarcopenic obesity in community-dwelling older adults: a cross-sectional study
items.summary: A cross-sectional study investigated the prevalence and sex/age-specific risk factors for possible sarcopenic obesity in community-dwelling older adults using traditional regression, Bayesian analysis, and machine learning methods.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究提供了关于社区居住老年人可能存在的肌少性肥胖的风险因素，并区分了性别和年龄特异性。这有助于你更精准地对老年患者进行筛查和风险管理，制定个性化的干预策略。
items.titleZh: 社区居住老年人可能存在的肌少性肥胖的性别和年龄特异性风险因素：一项横断面研究
items.summaryZh: 一项横断面研究利用传统回归、贝叶斯分析和机器学习方法，调查了社区居住老年人可能存在的肌少性肥胖的患病率及性别和年龄特异性风险因素。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study, using multiple advanced analytical methods, revealed the prevalence and sex/age-specific risk factors for sarcopenic obesity in community-dwelling older adults. This finding can help you more precisely identify high-risk elderly patients and develop more targeted intervention strategies in screening and risk management.
items.limitation: 本研究为横断面研究，无法建立因果关系，且结果可能受特定人群特征限制。
items.limitationEn: This was a cross-sectional study, unable to establish causality, and its results may be limited by specific population characteristics.

items.title: Gait adaptations and spinal curvature correlations following lumbar arthrodesis: an analytic cross-sectional study
items.summary: An analytic cross-sectional study investigated gait adaptations and spinal curvature correlations following lumbar arthrodesis, providing insights into biomechanical changes post-surgery.
items.curatedReason: 这项横断面研究分析了腰椎融合术后步态适应和脊柱曲度相关性。这有助于你理解融合术后患者的步态特征和代偿机制，指导康复评估和训练。
items.titleZh: 腰椎融合术后步态适应与脊柱曲度相关性：一项分析性横断面研究
items.summaryZh: 一项分析性横断面研究调查了腰椎融合术后步态适应与脊柱曲度相关性，为术后生物力学变化提供了见解。
items.curatedReasonEn: This cross-sectional study analyzes gait adaptations and spinal curvature correlations following lumbar arthrodesis. This can help you understand the gait characteristics and compensatory mechanisms of post-fusion patients, guiding rehabilitation assessment and training.
items.limitation: 本研究为横断面研究，无法建立因果关系，且可能受限于特定人群特征。
items.limitationEn: This was a cross-sectional study, unable to establish causality, and may be limited by specific population characteristics.

items.title: Quality indicators for Spanish hospital-based physical therapy units: a feasibility and inter-rater reliability study.
items.summary: A multicenter, observational study in three Spanish hospitals assessed 22 quality indicators for hospital-based physical therapy units, finding 13 were feasible and showed inter-rater reliability, identifying quality problems in clinical practice.
items.curatedReason: 这份来自西班牙三家医院的观察研究评估了 22 项物理治疗科室质量指标，发现其中 13 项可行且可靠，并指出了临床实践中的质量问题。如果你身处欧洲，这项研究的方法学和具体发现值得参考，以便你在本院开发或评估自己的质量管理体系。
items.titleZh: 西班牙医院物理治疗科室质量指标的可行性和评估者间信度研究
items.summaryZh: 一项在西班牙三家医院进行的多中心观察性研究评估了医院物理治疗科室的 22 项质量指标，发现其中 13 项可行且具有评估者间信度，并识别了临床实践中的质量问题。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study evaluated quality indicators for hospital-based physical therapy units in Spain. If you practice in European countries, its methodology and findings can serve as a reference for developing or assessing your own quality systems.
items.limitation: 本研究为观察性、描述性、横断面研究，且仅限于西班牙的三家医院，结果外推性有限。
items.limitationEn: This was an observational, descriptive, cross-sectional study limited to three hospitals in Spain, thus limiting generalizability.

items.title: Effects of Short-term High-intensity vs. Moderate-intensity Interval Training on Cardiopulmonary Fitness and Metabolic Health in Overweight or Obese Patients with Cardiovascular Disease: Evidence from China.
items.summary: A retrospective study of 145 overweight or obese CVD patients in China found that both 12 sessions of high-intensity interval training (HIIT) and moderate-intensity interval training (MIIT) over 4 weeks significantly improved cardiopulmonary fitness and metabolic health.
items.curatedReason: 这项来自中国的回顾性研究表明，对于超重或肥胖心血管疾病患者，高强度间歇训练（HIIT）和中等强度间歇训练（MIIT）都能改善心肺健康和代谢健康。这支持了在心肺康复中根据患者耐受性选择不同强度间歇训练方案。
items.titleZh: 短期高强度 vs. 中等强度间歇训练对超重或肥胖心血管疾病患者心肺功能和代谢健康的影响：来自中国的证据
items.summaryZh: 一项针对中国 145 名超重或肥胖心血管疾病患者的回顾性研究发现，为期 4 周的 12 次高强度间歇训练（HIIT）和中等强度间歇训练（MIIT）均能显著改善心肺功能和代谢健康。
items.curatedReasonEn: This retrospective study from China suggests that both high-intensity interval training (HIIT) and moderate-intensity interval training (MIIT) improve cardiopulmonary and metabolic health in overweight or obese cardiovascular disease patients. This supports choosing different intensity interval training protocols in cardiopulmonary rehabilitation based on patient tolerance.
items.limitation: 本研究为回顾性研究，存在选择偏倚和混杂因素的风险，且非随机分组。
items.limitationEn: This retrospective study carries risks of selection bias and confounding factors, and participants were not randomized.
items.journal: Archives of physical medicine and rehabilitation

items.title: Rapid growth in autism spectrum disorder referrals reshaped rehabilitation service use: A longitudinal cohort study of children and adolescents in Brazil
items.summary: A retrospective longitudinal study of children receiving developmental care in Brazil (2017-2026) revealed a rapid growth in autism spectrum disorder referrals, substantially increasing demand for long-term rehabilitation services and reshaping service utilization.
items.curatedReason: 孤独症谱系障碍（ASD）转诊量快速增长正在重塑康复服务的使用。这项研究提醒你关注 ASD 诊断增加对未来服务需求和排队时间的影响，尤其是在资源有限的地区。
items.titleZh: 孤独症谱系障碍转诊量快速增长重塑康复服务使用：一项巴西儿童和青少年纵向队列研究
items.summaryZh: 一项针对巴西接受发育护理儿童（2017-2026 年）的回顾性纵向研究显示，孤独症谱系障碍转诊量快速增长，大幅增加了对长期康复服务的需求，并重塑了服务利用模式。
items.curatedReasonEn: The rapid growth in autism spectrum disorder (ASD) referrals is reshaping rehabilitation service utilization. This study reminds you to pay attention to the impact of increasing ASD diagnoses on future service demand and wait times, especially in resource-limited areas.
items.limitation: 本研究为回顾性队列研究，且仅在巴西一个中心进行，结果外推性有限。
items.limitationEn: This was a retrospective cohort study conducted at a single center in Brazil, thus limiting generalizability.

items.title: Understanding Anterior Cruciate Ligament Adaptation: Structural, Mechanical, and Healing Considerations
items.summary: This review provides a comprehensive understanding of anterior cruciate ligament (ACL) adaptation, focusing on its structural, mechanical, and healing considerations relevant to sports medicine.
items.curatedReason: 这篇综述深入探讨了前交叉韧带（ACL）的结构、力学和愈合适应。它能帮助你更好地理解 ACL 损伤后的生物力学和康复机制，优化你的训练策略。
items.titleZh: 理解前交叉韧带适应性：结构、力学和愈合考量
items.summaryZh: 这篇综述全面阐述了前交叉韧带（ACL）的适应性，侧重于其在运动医学中相关的结构、力学和愈合考量。
items.curatedReasonEn: This review systematically synthesizes the structural, mechanical, and healing adaptation mechanisms of the ACL, offering a comprehensive understanding from a sports medicine perspective. It can deepen your understanding of post-ACL injury biomechanical changes, allowing for more precise rehabilitation program design and optimized patient training strategies.
items.limitation: 本研究为综述，未提供新的原始数据，其结论基于现有文献的解释和整合。
items.limitationEn: This is a review, not providing new original data, and its conclusions are based on the interpretation and integration of existing literature.

items.title: Beyond the incision: Does release extent matter in congenital muscular torticollis? A systematic review
items.summary: A systematic review investigates whether the extent of surgical release matters in congenital muscular torticollis, analyzing its impact beyond the incision.

items.titleZh: 超越切口：先天性肌性斜颈中松解范围是否重要？一项系统综述
items.summaryZh: 一项系统综述探讨了先天性肌性斜颈中手术松解范围是否重要，分析了其在切口之外的影响。
items.curatedReasonEn: This systematic review delves into the importance of the extent of surgical release in congenital muscular torticollis. While a surgical topic, understanding how different degrees of release impact postoperative outcomes can help you better collaborate with surgical teams and adjust postoperative rehabilitation protocols for optimal results.
items.limitation: 本研究为系统综述，其结论的强度取决于纳入研究的质量和异质性。
items.limitationEn: This is a systematic review, and the strength of its conclusions depends on the quality and heterogeneity of the included studies.

items.title: the Exercise Harms Reporting Method (ExHaRM) - BMJ Open

items.curatedReasonEn: This paper introduces the Exercise Harms Reporting Method (ExHaRM), aiming to improve adverse event reporting in exercise oncology. When designing exercise programs for oncology patients, this provides a more standardized framework for harm reporting.
items.limitation: 该文章提出了方法学建议，但并未提供该方法在实际应用中的有效性或影响的实证数据。
items.limitationEn: This article proposes methodological suggestions but does not provide empirical data on the effectiveness or impact of the method in practical application.

items.title: Comparative effectiveness of azithromycin versus roflumilast in patients with chronic obstructive pulmonary disease: emulated target trial

items.curatedReasonEn: This paper compares the effectiveness of two drugs (azithromycin versus roflumilast) in patients with chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD). items.title: Hydrodilatation for adhesive capsulitis: a systematic review exploring efficacy and optimal technique.
items.summary: A systematic review including 103 studies (9951 patients, 44 RCTs) explored the efficacy of hydrodilatation for idiopathic adhesive capsulitis, finding a mean hydrodilatation volume of 36.0±26.3 mL (median 28 mL).
items.curatedReason: 肩周炎水扩张的疗效仍需更多高质量 RCT 验证，但中等容量（28-36 mL）是常见实践。这篇系统综述告诉你，当下文献还不能给出确定性的最佳方案。
items.titleZh: 肩周炎水扩张术：系统综述探讨疗效与最佳技术
items.summaryZh: 一项包含 103 项研究（9951 名患者，44 项 RCT）的系统综述评估了特发性肩周炎水扩张术的疗效，发现平均扩张量为 36.0±26.3 mL（中位数 28 mL）。
items.curatedReasonEn: The efficacy of hydrodilatation for adhesive capsulitis still requires more high-quality RCTs, but medium volumes (28-36 mL) are common in practice. This systematic review indicates that current literature cannot provide a definitive optimal technique.
items.limitation: 原始研究异质性高，且尚不能从文献中提炼出明确的最佳水扩张技术。
items.limitationEn: High heterogeneity among original studies, and the literature currently does not allow for identifying a clear optimal hydrodilatation technique.

items.summaryZh: APTA 获邀向一个重要的国会核心小组提供关于 Medicare 支付改革的信息，突显了该行业日益增长的影响力。
items.curatedReasonEn: APTA's invitation to inform a key Congressional caucus on Medicare payment reform indicates the increasing importance of physical therapy within the healthcare system. This is a crucial step for the profession to gain influence at the policy level.

items.curatedReasonEn: New PTs or colleagues with questions about Medicare Part B reimbursement details should consider this free APTA course. It will help you more accurately understand and navigate Medicare regulations and processes.

items.title: Experiences of frontline physiotherapists during the COVID-19 pandemic at two tertiary hospitals in Southern Malawi: A phenomenological qualitative study
items.summary: A phenomenological qualitative study explored the experiences of 11 frontline physiotherapists in two tertiary hospitals in Southern Malawi during the COVID-19 pandemic, aiming to inform future workforce support plans.
items.curatedReason: 这次疫情让我们看到，像马拉维这样资源有限地区的 11 位前线物理治疗师，在疫情期间面临巨大压力，急需完善的心理支持和物资保障。别再把这些定性研究当成可有可无的，它们能直接告诉我们如何改进未来的紧急响应计划。
items.titleZh: COVID-19 疫情期间马拉维南部两家三级医院前线物理治疗师的经历：一项现象学定性研究
items.summaryZh: 一项现象学定性研究调查了 COVID-19 疫情期间马拉维南部两家三级医院的 11 名前线物理治疗师的经历，旨在为未来的劳动力支持计划提供信息。
items.curatedReasonEn: The pandemic highlighted that 11 frontline physiotherapists in resource-limited settings like Malawi faced immense pressure and urgently needed better psychological support and material resources. Stop dismissing these qualitative studies; they directly inform how we can improve future emergency response plans.
items.limitation: 这是一项定性研究，仅在马拉维的两个医院采访了 11 名物理治疗师，结果不具有普遍性，但提供了深入的个体经验。
items.limitationEn: This qualitative study interviewed only 11 physiotherapists in two Malawian hospitals, so the findings are not generalizable but offer in-depth individual experiences.

items.title: Applying the International Classification of Functioning, Disability and Health to Classify Upper Limb Outcome Measures in Stroke Rehabilitation: A Construct-Driven Perspective.
items.summary: This perspective piece applies the International Classification of Functioning, Disability and Health (ICF) to clarify the classification of upper limb outcome measures in stroke rehabilitation, emphasizing that scoring criteria, not just item content, should define what is being assessed.
items.curatedReason: 本研究提醒你在卒中上肢康复中，评估工具的分类应更侧重其评分标准而非表面任务内容。这有助于避免混淆功能障碍与活动受限的恢复，确保康复计划的精准性。
items.titleZh: 应用国际功能、残疾和健康分类（ICF）对卒中康复上肢结局测量工具进行分类：一个概念驱动的视角
items.summaryZh: 这篇述评文章运用国际功能、残疾和健康分类（ICF）框架，阐明了卒中康复中上肢结局测量工具的分类方式，强调应以评分标准而非仅仅项目内容来界定评估重点，以避免混淆功能障碍与活动受限。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study reminds you that in stroke upper limb rehabilitation, the classification of assessment tools should prioritize their scoring criteria over superficial task content. This helps avoid confusing impairment recovery with activity limitation, ensuring precise rehabilitation planning.
items.limitation: 本述评为概念性分析，未提供实证数据支持其分类框架。
items.limitationEn: This commentary is a conceptual analysis and does not provide empirical data to support its classification framework.

items.title: Test-Retest Reliability of Hierarchical Proprioception Assessment of the Wrist
items.summary: This study evaluated the within-day test-retest reliability of three robotic wrist tasks—joint detection threshold (JDT), same-frame joint-to-joint matching (J-to-J), and cross-frame joint-to-visual matching (J-to-V)—in 20 neurotypical adults.
items.curatedReason: 腕关节本体感觉评估的层级任务（运动检测、关节位置匹配、跨参照系匹配）的信效度研究仍然稀缺。本研究提供了不同类型任务的信度数据，可作为你选择临床评估工具的参考。
items.titleZh: 腕关节分级本体感觉评估的重测信度
items.summaryZh: 这项研究评估了20名神经正常成年人进行的三种机器人腕关节任务（关节检测阈值、同框架关节匹配、跨框架关节-视觉匹配）的日内重测信度，以比较不同层级本体感觉判断的表现。
items.curatedReasonEn: Hierarchical proprioception assessment for the wrist, covering tasks like movement detection, joint position matching, and cross-reference frame matching, still lacks robust psychometric data. This study provides reliability data for different task types, informing your choice of clinical assessment tools.
items.limitation: 本研究的局限在于样本量较小，且研究对象为神经正常成人，结果外推至不同患者群体需谨慎。
items.limitationEn: The study is limited by its small sample size and enrollment of neurotypical adults, so results should be cautiously generalized to diverse patient populations.

items.title: The Influence of Hand Muscle Fatigue on Fine Motor Performance During Selected Activities of Daily Living in Healthy Adults.
items.summary: This study investigated whether hand muscle fatigue impairs fine motor performance in 30 healthy university students during 11 ADL-inspired tasks, comparing task scores and completion times pre- and post-fatigue.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究表明，手部肌肉疲劳可能足以影响健康成年人的精细运动表现。在评估患者手部功能障碍时，你应将肌肉疲劳作为一个潜在的混杂因素考虑在内。
items.titleZh: 手部肌肉疲劳对健康成年人部分日常生活活动精细运动表现的影响
items.summaryZh: 这项研究评估了30名健康大学生在11项模拟日常生活活动中，手部肌肉疲劳是否会损害精细运动表现，通过比较疲劳前后任务得分和完成时间。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study suggests that hand muscle fatigue alone may be sufficient to impair fine motor performance in healthy adults. When assessing hand dysfunction in patients, consider muscle fatigue as a potential confounding factor.
items.limitation: 本研究的局限在于仅纳入健康成年男性和女性，结果可能无法直接推广到有手部病理状况的患者群体。
items.limitationEn: The study is limited by its inclusion of only healthy male and female adults, meaning results may not directly generalize to patient populations with hand pathologies.

items.title: Updated Clinical Practice Guideline for Physical Therapist Management After TKA
items.summary: The American Physical Therapy Association (APTA) has published an updated clinical practice guideline for physical therapist management of patients undergoing total knee arthroplasty (TKA) for osteoarthritis, offering evidence-based recommendations for various aspects of care.
items.curatedReason: 这份由 APTA 发布的 TKA 术后管理指南更新，提供了从术前宣教到术后康复、疼痛管理的全方位循证建议。它整合了最新证据，将直接影响你未来对全膝关节置换患者的临床实践。
items.titleZh: APTA 发布 TKA 术后物理治疗管理临床实践指南更新
items.summaryZh: 美国物理治疗协会 (APTA) 发布了针对骨关节炎全膝关节置换 (TKA) 患者的物理治疗管理临床实践指南更新，为术前宣教、术后康复、强化训练、步态训练、疼痛管理等方面提供了循证建议。
items.curatedReasonEn: This updated APTA guideline for post-TKA management provides comprehensive evidence-based recommendations, from preoperative education to postoperative rehabilitation and pain management. It integrates the latest evidence and will directly impact your clinical practice for total knee arthroplasty patients.

items.title: Effects of sportsmetrics training on biomechanical and functional performance outcomes related to ACL injury risk: a systematic review and meta-analysis
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis investigated the effects of Sportsmetrics training on biomechanical and functional performance outcomes related to ACL injury risk.
items.curatedReason: Sportsmetrics 训练确实能改善与 ACL 损伤风险相关的生物力学和功能表现。鉴于这是高质量系统综述（评分 85），你可以考虑在青少年运动员的 ACL 预防方案中纳入 Sportsmetrics。
items.titleZh: Sportsmetrics 训练对 ACL 损伤风险相关生物力学和功能表现结局的影响：一项系统综述和荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 一项系统综述和荟萃分析评估了 Sportsmetrics 训练对与前交叉韧带 (ACL) 损伤风险相关的生物力学和功能表现结局的影响。
items.curatedReasonEn: Sportsmetrics training effectively improves biomechanical and functional performance outcomes linked to ACL injury risk. Given this is a high-quality systematic review (score 85), you should consider incorporating Sportsmetrics into ACL prevention programs for adolescent athletes.
items.limitation: 综述纳入研究的异质性可能影响了结果的统一性。
items.limitationEn: The heterogeneity of included studies in the review might affect the consistency of results.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: First trial confirms swimming reduces disability from chronic back pain
items.summary: The EduSwim clinical trial, guided by a physiotherapist, found an eight-week individualized program of swimming and education significantly improved function and pain in people with chronic low back pain compared to education alone.
items.curatedReason: 这项 RCT 首次证实了游泳对慢性腰痛导致功能障碍的临床有效性。你可以更有信心地将个体化游泳康复方案推荐给慢性腰痛患者，尤其是在教育咨询的基础上。
items.titleZh: 首次试验证实游泳可减轻慢性腰痛导致的功能障碍
items.summaryZh: 一项名为 EduSwim 的临床试验首次证实，由物理治疗师指导的八周个体化游泳加教育项目，在改善慢性腰痛患者的功能和疼痛方面，显著优于单纯教育。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT is the first to confirm the clinical effectiveness of swimming in reducing disability from chronic low back pain. You can recommend individualized swimming rehabilitation programs to chronic low back pain patients with more confidence, especially when combined with educational counseling.
items.limitation: 研究关注的是游泳和教育的联合效果，难以独立评估游泳本身的纯粹效应。
items.limitationEn: The study focused on the combined effect of swimming and education, making it difficult to independently assess the pure effect of swimming itself.

items.title: APTA Regulatory, Legislative, and Payment Updates Series (2026)
items.summary: APTA's Health Policy and Payment team will provide an overview of the most significant federal regulatory and commercial payer policy updates for 2026, crucial for physical therapists' practice.
items.curatedReason: APTA 的 2026 年监管、立法和支付更新系列，直接关系到你作为物理治疗师的执业和收入。你需要密切关注这些联邦和商业支付方的政策变化，以便调整你的诊所运营和报销策略。
items.titleZh: APTA 2026 年监管、立法和支付更新系列
items.summaryZh: APTA 的健康政策与支付团队将概述 2026 年最重要的联邦监管和商业支付方政策更新，这对于物理治疗师的执业至关重要。
items.curatedReasonEn: APTA's 2026 Regulatory, Legislative, and Payment Updates Series directly impacts your practice and income as a physical therapist. You need to closely monitor these federal and commercial payer policy changes to adjust your clinic operations and reimbursement strategies.

items.title: Proposed '27 Home Health Rule: 2.4% Increase Likely Reduced by PDGM Adjustments
items.summary: CMS has proposed updates to the Calendar Year 2027 Home Health Prospective Payment System, indicating a 2.4% payment increase that is likely to be reduced by PDGM adjustments, with comments due by August 31, 2026.
items.curatedReason: CMS 提出的 2027 年家庭健康规则草案预示着潜在的支付调整，虽然有 2.4% 的名义增长，但 PDGM 调整可能导致实际削减。如果你提供家庭健康物理治疗服务，这份拟议规则将直接影响你的收入和运营模式，必须关注并在 8 月 31 日前提交意见。
items.titleZh: CMS 提出 2027 年家庭健康规则：2.4% 增长可能因 PDGM 调整而减少
items.summaryZh: CMS 已提出 2027 财年家庭健康预付款系统更新，预示支付将增加 2.4%，但可能会因 PDGM 调整而减少；意见征集截止日期为 2026 年 8 月 31 日。
items.curatedReasonEn: CMS's proposed 2027 Home Health Rule signals potential payment adjustments; despite a nominal 2.4% increase, PDGM adjustments may lead to actual cuts. If you provide home health physical therapy services, this proposed rule will directly impact your revenue and operating model. You must pay attention and submit comments by August 31.

items.title: Local Coverage Determinations
items.summary: CMS outlines Local Coverage Determinations (LCDs), defining them as determinations by fiscal intermediaries or carriers regarding Medicare Part A or Part B service coverage, and provides resources on the LCD process modernization.
items.curatedReason: CMS 关于本地覆盖决定 (LCD) 的指南详细阐述了这些决定如何影响 Medicare A 和 B 部分服务的覆盖。理解 LCD 的制定过程和内容，对你在美国市场的日常报销和执业至关重要。
items.titleZh: 本地覆盖决定 (LCD)——CMS 指南
items.summaryZh: CMS 阐述了本地覆盖决定 (LCDs)，将其定义为财务中介或承运人就 Medicare A 部分或 B 部分服务是否被覆盖所做的决定，并提供了 LCD 流程现代化的相关资源。
items.curatedReasonEn: CMS guidelines on Local Coverage Determinations (LCDs) detail how these decisions affect Medicare Parts A and B services. Understanding the LCD development process and content is crucial for your daily reimbursement and practice in the US market.

items.title: Change in Mental Health and Resilience in Childhood Cancer Survivors After Attending a Person-Centred State-of-the-Art Late Effects Clinic-on Behalf of the PanCareFollowUp Consortium
items.summary: An observational study investigated changes in mental health and resilience in childhood cancer survivors after attending a person-centered state-of-the-art late effects clinic.
items.curatedReason: 这项观察研究表明，参加以患者为中心的先进晚期效应诊所可以改善儿童癌症幸存者的心理健康和韧性。你可以将这类综合性、以患者为中心的护理模式纳入考虑，以期提升你所管理儿童癌症幸存者的生活质量。
items.titleZh: 参加以患者为中心的先进晚期效应诊所后儿童癌症幸存者心理健康和韧性的变化
items.summaryZh: 一项观察性研究评估了儿童癌症幸存者在参加以患者为中心的先进晚期效应诊所后，其心理健康和韧性的变化情况。
items.curatedReasonEn: This observational study indicates that attending a person-centered state-of-the-art late effects clinic can improve mental health and resilience in childhood cancer survivors. You can consider incorporating such comprehensive, person-centered care models to enhance the quality of life for the childhood cancer survivors you manage.
items.limitation: 作为观察性研究，难以建立直接的因果关系。
items.limitationEn: As an observational study, it is difficult to establish a direct causal relationship.

items.title: Exercise training during hospitalization in community-acquired pneumonia: effects on functional ability, body composition, and physical activity level
items.summary: Research published in Aging Clinical and Experimental Research investigated the effects of exercise training during hospitalization for community-acquired pneumonia on functional ability, body composition, and physical activity level.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究表明，在社区获得性肺炎住院期间进行运动训练，可改善患者的功能能力、身体成分和身体活动水平。你可以将早期康复干预纳入这类住院患者的管理，以促进其恢复。
items.titleZh: 社区获得性肺炎住院期间运动训练对功能能力、身体成分和身体活动水平的影响
items.summaryZh: 发表在《老化临床与实验研究》上的研究探讨了社区获得性肺炎患者住院期间进行运动训练，对其功能能力、身体成分和身体活动水平的影响。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study indicates that exercise training during hospitalization for community-acquired pneumonia can improve patients' functional ability, body composition, and physical activity levels. You can integrate early rehabilitation interventions into the management of such hospitalized patients to promote their recovery.
items.limitation: 研究未明确提及对照组设置，可能影响结果的独立归因。
items.limitationEn: The study does not explicitly mention the control group setup, which may affect the independent attribution of results.

items.title: Effects of transcranial direct current stimulation (tDCS ... - BMJ Open
items.summary: A double-blind, randomized, placebo-controlled study investigated the effects of transcranial direct current stimulation (tDCS) and concurrent cognitive training on episodic memory in patients with traumatic brain injury.
items.curatedReason: 这项 RCT 探索了经颅直流电刺激 (tDCS) 与认知训练对创伤性脑损伤患者情景记忆的影响。尽管是早期研究，但它提示了新的非药物干预组合的潜力，为你未来综合治疗方案的考虑提供了一个方向。
items.titleZh: 经颅直流电刺激 (tDCS) 联合认知训练对创伤性脑损伤患者情景记忆的影响：一项随机对照研究
items.summaryZh: 一项双盲、随机、安慰剂对照研究评估了经颅直流电刺激 (tDCS) 联合同期认知训练对创伤性脑损伤患者情景记忆的影响。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT explores the effects of transcranial direct current stimulation (tDCS) combined with cognitive training on episodic memory in traumatic brain injury patients. Although an early study, it suggests the potential of new non-pharmacological intervention combinations, offering a direction for your future consideration of comprehensive treatment plans.
items.limitation: 样本量较小，结果可能需要大型研究进一步验证。
items.limitationEn: The sample size is relatively small, and results may require further validation in larger studies.

items.title: What percentage of severely impaired stroke survivors retain residual voluntary EMG?
items.summary: An exploratory study with 100 severely impaired stroke survivors investigated the presence of residual electromyography (EMG) activity in wrist extensor muscles, even in the absence of visible movement, suggesting feasibility for EMG-based human-machine interaction.
items.curatedReason: 这项探索性研究提示，即便重度卒中患者手腕无可见主动运动，仍有高比例存在残余肌电信号。这为开发基于 EMG 的康复界面提供了初步依据，但目前还无法指导临床实践。
items.titleZh: 重度卒中幸存者中残余自主肌电图的比例
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 100 名重度卒中幸存者的探索性研究显示，即使腕关节无可见主动运动，仍有残余肌电活动，这为开发基于肌电图的人机交互康复技术提供了可行性证据。
items.curatedReasonEn: This exploratory study suggests a high percentage of severely impaired stroke survivors, even those with no visible wrist movement, retain residual EMG activity. This provides preliminary evidence for developing EMG-based rehabilitation interfaces but does not yet inform clinical practice.
items.limitation: 这是一项探索性横断面研究，样本量相对较小且仅关注腕伸肌，结果的外推性有限。
items.limitationEn: This is an exploratory cross-sectional study with a relatively small sample size, focusing only on wrist extensor muscles, limiting the generalizability of the findings.

items.title: The effect of online physical activity monitoring on physical activity level, psychological health, fatigue, and quality of life in patients with multiple sclerosis: a randomized controlled trial.
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial with 42 MS patients showed that continuous online physical activity monitoring with messaging app reminders improved physical activity levels, psychological health, and quality of life.
items.curatedReason: 在线身体活动监测结合提醒能够有效提升多发性硬化症患者的身体活动水平。将这种相对低成本的干预整合到你的患者管理中，有望改善患者的健康状况和生活质量。
items.titleZh: 在线身体活动监测对多发性硬化症患者身体活动水平、心理健康、疲劳和生活质量的影响：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项纳入 42 名多发性硬化症患者的随机对照试验显示，通过消息应用提醒进行的持续在线身体活动监测，能够改善患者的身体活动水平、心理健康和生活质量。
items.curatedReasonEn: Online physical activity monitoring combined with reminders can effectively increase physical activity levels in patients with multiple sclerosis. Integrating this relatively low-cost intervention into your patient management holds promise for improving patient health and quality of life.
items.limitation: 研究样本量较小，且随访时间有限，长期效果和更广泛人群的适用性有待大型研究验证。
items.limitationEn: The study had a small sample size and limited follow-up duration; long-term effects and applicability to a broader population require validation through larger studies.

items.title: Measurements and management of multiple sclerosis-related fatigue: an umbrella review and meta-analysis.
items.summary: An umbrella review and meta-analysis of 46 systematic reviews found that exercise provided the most consistent benefit for MS-related fatigue, with aerobic training showing a modest reduction (SMD -0.32) and resistance exercise a significant reduction (SMD -1.09).
items.curatedReason: 这项伞形综述坐实了运动疗法在多发性硬化症（MS）相关疲劳管理中的核心地位。尤其是，有氧训练和阻力训练都显示出中等至显著的疲劳改善效应。把运动处方纳入 MS 患者的常规管理方案。
items.titleZh: 多发性硬化症相关疲劳的测量与管理：一项伞形综述和荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 一项包含 46 篇系统综述的伞形综述和荟萃分析发现，运动疗法对多发性硬化症（MS）相关疲劳的益处最一致，其中有氧训练显示出适度缓解（SMD -0.32），阻力训练则显示出显著缓解（SMD -1.09）。
items.curatedReasonEn: This umbrella review confirms the central role of exercise therapy in managing multiple sclerosis (MS)-related fatigue. Specifically, both aerobic and resistance training showed moderate to significant effects in reducing fatigue. Integrate exercise prescriptions into the routine management of MS patients.
items.limitation: 纳入的系统综述在方法学质量和报告异质性方面存在差异，可能影响了综合证据的强度。
items.limitationEn: The included systematic reviews varied in methodological quality and reporting heterogeneity, which may affect the strength of the synthesized evidence.

items.title: Biopsychosocial predictors of functional recovery in chronic low back pain following physiotherapy: A survival analysis study.
items.summary: A prospective observational cohort study of 250 adults with chronic nonspecific low back pain found that biopsychosocial factors, including pain intensity and kinesiophobia, significantly predicted functional recovery time after physiotherapy.
items.curatedReason: 这项前瞻性观察研究提示，慢性下腰痛患者进行物理治疗后的功能恢复，很大程度上受生物心理社会因素影响，特别是疼痛强度和恐惧回避信念。在制定康复计划时，除了生理功能，别忽视这些因素的评估和干预。
items.titleZh: 物理治疗后慢性下腰痛功能恢复的生物心理社会预测因子：一项生存分析研究
items.summaryZh: 一项对 250 名慢性非特异性下腰痛成年患者进行物理治疗的前瞻性观察性队列研究发现，生物心理社会因素，包括疼痛强度和运动恐惧症，显著预测了功能恢复时间。
items.curatedReasonEn: This prospective observational study suggests that functional recovery in chronic low back pain patients after physiotherapy is significantly influenced by biopsychosocial factors, particularly pain intensity and kinesiophobia. When developing rehabilitation plans, do not overlook the assessment and intervention for these factors in addition to physical function.
items.limitation: 本研究为观察性设计，无法确立因果关系，且随访时间较短，主要结局指标依赖主观量表。
items.limitationEn: This observational study cannot establish causality, has a relatively short follow-up, and relies on subjective scales for primary outcomes.

items.title: Simplifying ICF Assessment for Individuals with Spinal Cord Injury with Lower Limb Dysfunction Using Item Response Theory and Graphical Models.
items.summary: This multicenter cross-sectional study developed and validated a parameterized assessment tool for individuals with spinal cord injury (SCI) with lower limb dysfunction, based on the ICF, using item response theory (IRT) and graphical modeling (GM). The study involved 252 participants from multiple rehabilitation centers in China.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究利用先进的心理测量学方法，为脊髓损伤患者下肢功能障碍的 ICF 评估提供了一个更精简、标准化的工具。在临床中，这意味着你可能能用更高效的方式来评估患者的功能状态，但记住这还处于工具开发阶段。
items.titleZh: 基于项目反应理论和图模型简化脊髓损伤患者下肢功能障碍的 ICF 评估
items.summaryZh: 这项多中心横断面研究旨在开发和验证一个基于 ICF、利用项目反应理论（IRT）和图模型（GM）的脊髓损伤患者下肢功能障碍参数化评估工具。该研究纳入了来自中国多个康复中心的 252 名参与者。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study offers a streamlined, standardized ICF assessment tool for lower limb dysfunction in SCI patients using advanced psychometrics. Clinically, this could mean more efficient functional status assessment, but remember this is still in the tool development phase.
items.limitation: 研究为横断面设计，且工具尚处于开发和验证阶段，需进一步的前瞻性研究和临床应用检验。
items.limitationEn: The study is cross-sectional, and the tool is still in development and validation, requiring further prospective research and clinical application testing.
items.journal: Archives of physical medicine and rehabilitation

items.title: Understanding the family planning experiences and information needs of people living with multiple sclerosis: an Australian cohort study.
items.summary: This Australian cross-sectional cohort study, involving 270 participants from the Australian Multiple Sclerosis Longitudinal Study (mean age 42.7 years), investigated the impact of MS on family planning experiences and information needs. Nearly half (44.0%) reported MS impacting reproductive decisions, with 14.7% deciding against having children due to MS.
items.curatedReason: 这项澳大利亚队列研究揭示了多发性硬化症（MS）患者在生育决策上面临的挑战和信息需求。作为 PT，你在与 MS 患者沟通时，应注意他们可能存在的生育顾虑，并在专业允许范围内提供相关资源或转诊建议，以更好地支持他们的整体生活质量。
items.titleZh: 了解多发性硬化症患者的生育计划经验和信息需求：一项澳大利亚队列研究
items.summaryZh: 这项澳大利亚横断面队列研究纳入了 270 名澳大利亚多发性硬化症纵向研究的参与者（平均年龄 42.7 岁），旨在了解 MS 对生育计划经验的影响和信息需求。近一半（44.0%）的受访者表示 MS 影响了其生育决策，其中 14.7% 因 MS 决定不生育。
items.curatedReasonEn: This Australian cohort study highlights challenges and information needs for people with multiple sclerosis (MS) regarding reproductive decisions. As a PT, when communicating with MS patients, be aware of their potential fertility concerns and, within your scope, offer relevant resources or referral advice to better support their overall quality of life.
items.limitation: 研究为横断面设计，无法建立因果关系，且数据依赖自我报告。
items.limitationEn: The study is cross-sectional, precluding causal inference, and relies on self-reported data.

items.title: Effect of Combined Aerobic and Resistance Training on Exercise Capacity, Muscle Strength, Quality of Life, and Mortality in Patients with Coronary Heart Disease: A Systematic Review with Meta-analysis
items.summary: A systematic review with meta-analysis found that combined aerobic and resistance training (CART) significantly improves exercise capacity, muscle strength, quality of life, and reduces mortality in patients with coronary heart disease.
items.curatedReason: 这项系统综述和 Meta 分析确认了有氧与抗阻联合训练（CART）对冠心病患者运动能力、肌肉力量、生活质量和死亡率的益处，为你将 CART 纳入心血管康复方案提供了强有力证据。
items.titleZh: 有氧与抗阻联合训练对冠心病患者运动能力、肌肉力量、生活质量和死亡率的影响：一项系统综述与 Meta 分析
items.summaryZh: 一项系统综述与 Meta 分析发现，有氧与抗阻联合训练（CART）显著改善冠心病患者的运动能力、肌肉力量、生活质量并降低死亡率。
items.curatedReasonEn: This systematic review and meta-analysis provides strong evidence that combined aerobic and resistance training (CART) is crucial for patients with coronary heart disease. You should actively recommend and implement CART, as it significantly improves exercise capacity, muscle strength, quality of life, and reduces mortality.
items.limitation: 虽然是系统综述，但纳入研究的异质性（如训练方案、患者特征）可能影响结果的总体适用性。
items.limitationEn: Although a systematic review, heterogeneity among included studies (e.g., training protocols, patient characteristics) may affect the overall applicability of the results.

items.title: Proposed 2027 Medicare Physician Fee Schedule: What PTs Need to Know, Part 2
items.summary: The U.S. Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services' proposed 2027 Medicare Physician Fee Schedule includes plans to reshape the Medicare Quality Payment Program by ending the Merit-based Incentive Payment System (MIPS) in 2029.
items.curatedReason: APTA 对 2027 年 Medicare 医生收费标准拟议规则的解读指出，CMS 计划在 2029 年结束 MIPS，这将直接影响你在美国市场的绩效支付和质量报告策略，必须提前规划。
items.titleZh: 2027 年 Medicare 医生收费标准拟议规则：物理治疗师需要了解什么，第二部分
items.summaryZh: 美国医疗保险和医疗补助服务中心（CMS）提议的 2027 年 Medicare 医生收费标准包括计划于 2029 年终止绩效奖励支付系统（MIPS），以重塑 Medicare 质量支付计划。
items.curatedReasonEn: APTA's interpretation of the proposed 2027 Medicare Physician Fee Schedule indicates CMS's plan to end MIPS in 2029. This will directly impact your performance-based payment and quality reporting strategies in the U.S. market, requiring advance planning.
items.limitation: 此为拟议规则，最终版本可能有所调整；报道基于 APTA 的解读，并非 CMS 官方原文，需关注最终发布文件。
items.limitationEn: This is a proposed rule, and the final version may be adjusted; the report is based on APTA's interpretation, not the official CMS text, so pay attention to the final published document.

items.title: Prior Authorization for Certain Hospital Outpatient Department (OPD) Services
items.summary: CMS established a nationwide prior authorization process for certain hospital outpatient department (OPD) services through the Calendar Year 2020 Outpatient Prospective Payment System/Ambulatory Surgical Center Final Rule, aimed at controlling unnecessary volume increases and protecting the Medicare Trust Fund.
items.curatedReason: CMS 针对某些医院门诊部服务设立了事前授权程序，这直接影响你在美国市场为 Medicare 患者提供服务的流程和报销，务必熟悉相关规定以确保合规和减少拒付。
items.titleZh: 某些医院门诊部服务的事前授权 | CMS
items.summaryZh: CMS 通过 2020 财年门诊前瞻性支付系统/门诊手术中心最终规则，为某些医院门诊部（OPD）服务建立了全国性的事前授权流程，旨在控制不必要的服务量增长并保护 Medicare 信托基金。
items.curatedReasonEn: CMS has established a prior authorization process for certain hospital outpatient department services. This directly impacts your procedures and reimbursement for Medicare patients in the U.S. market. You must be familiar with these regulations to ensure compliance and reduce claim denials.
items.limitation: 该政策已在 2020 年生效，本条目仅为背景介绍和概述，未提供最新具体的细节变更。
items.limitationEn: This policy came into effect in 2020; this entry is merely background and an overview, not providing the latest specific detailed changes.

items.title: Short-term inspiratory muscle training, aerobic exercise, and detraining in women with COPD: a randomized controlled trial
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial investigated the effects of short-term inspiratory muscle training, aerobic exercise, and detraining in women with COPD.
items.curatedReason: 这项随机对照试验表明，短期吸气肌训练和有氧运动对慢阻肺（COPD）女性患者有效，即使停训后仍有一定益处，为你将这些干预纳入 COPD 康复计划提供了实践依据。
items.titleZh: 短期吸气肌训练、有氧运动及停训对慢阻肺女性患者的影响：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项随机对照试验研究了短期吸气肌训练、有氧运动及停训对慢阻肺（COPD）女性患者的影响。
items.curatedReasonEn: This randomized controlled trial shows that short-term inspiratory muscle training and aerobic exercise are effective for women with COPD, with some benefits persisting after detraining, providing practical evidence for you to incorporate these interventions into COPD rehabilitation programs.
items.limitation: 研究对象为女性 COPD 患者，结果对男性患者或不同疾病严重程度的患者外推时需谨慎。
items.limitationEn: The study involved female COPD patients, so results should be extrapolated with caution to male patients or those with different disease severities.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Altered inter-joint coordination strategies of the lower extremity and pelvis in elite rowers with chronic low back pain
items.summary: This study investigated altered inter-joint coordination strategies of the lower extremity and pelvis in elite rowers experiencing chronic low back pain, identifying specific biomechanical differences.
items.curatedReason: 精英赛艇运动员的慢性腰痛可能与特定的下肢和骨盆协调策略改变有关。在评估这类患者时，你应当关注其生物力学模式，这提示我们康复干预可能需要更精细的生物力学分析。
items.titleZh: 精英赛艇运动员慢性腰痛时下肢和骨盆的关节间协调策略改变
items.summaryZh: 这项研究调查了患有慢性腰痛的精英赛艇运动员下肢和骨盆关节间协调策略的改变，识别了特定的生物力学差异。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study reveals altered lower extremity and pelvic coordination strategies in elite rowers with chronic low back pain, helping you understand biomechanical compensation patterns in this specific athletic population.
items.limitation: 本研究为观察性研究，样本量和数据分析方法未在摘要中明确提及，无法确定因果关系。
items.limitationEn: This is an observational study; sample size and data analysis methods were not specified in the abstract, limiting the ability to determine causality.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Low‐intensity focused ultrasound neuromodulation for drug‐resistant epilepsy: A randomized, sham‐controlled crossover trial
items.summary: A randomized, sham-controlled crossover trial found low-intensity focused ultrasound neuromodulation safe and well tolerated for drug-resistant epilepsy, with delayed seizure reduction suggesting potential sustained effects, though primary analysis lacked statistical significance.
items.curatedReason: 这项 RCT 虽未在主要分析中显示统计学显著性，但证实低强度聚焦超声神经调控治疗难治性癫痫是安全的且耐受性良好。此外，其提示的延迟性癫痫发作减少值得你持续关注，这可能意味着治疗存在潜在的持续效应，仍有进一步研究的价值。
items.titleZh: 低强度聚焦超声神经调控治疗难治性癫痫：一项随机、假对照交叉试验
items.summaryZh: 一项随机、假对照交叉试验发现，低强度聚焦超声神经调控治疗难治性癫痫安全且耐受性良好，虽主要分析未达统计学显著性，但延迟性癫痫发作减少提示其潜在的持续效应。
items.curatedReasonEn: While this RCT did not show statistical significance in its primary analysis, it confirms that low-intensity focused ultrasound neuromodulation for drug-resistant epilepsy is safe and well-tolerated. Furthermore, the suggested delayed seizure reduction is worth your continued attention, as it may imply potential sustained effects, meriting further research.
items.limitation: 主要交叉分析未显示统计学显著疗效，且需要更大规模、更长随访期的平行组试验来证实延迟效应和长期疗效。
items.limitationEn: The primary crossover analysis did not show statistically significant efficacy, and larger parallel-group trials with longer observation periods are needed to confirm delayed effects and long-term efficacy.

items.title: Network analysis of frailty, sleep quality, and life satisfaction in older patients: a cross-sectional study stratified by chronic disease burden
items.summary: This cross-sectional study used network analysis to examine the interplay of frailty, sleep quality, and life satisfaction in older patients, stratified by chronic disease burden.
items.curatedReason: 这项基于网络分析的横断面研究揭示了老年患者衰弱、睡眠质量和生活满意度之间的复杂关联，特别是在不同慢性病负担下，有助于你更全面地理解老年综合征。
items.titleZh: 老年患者衰弱、睡眠质量和生活满意度的网络分析：一项按慢性病负担分层的横断面研究
items.summaryZh: 这项横断面研究采用网络分析法，探讨了老年患者衰弱、睡眠质量和生活满意度之间的相互作用，并根据慢性病负担进行了分层。
items.curatedReasonEn: This network analysis-based cross-sectional study reveals complex associations between frailty, sleep quality, and life satisfaction in older patients, especially under varying chronic disease burdens, helping you to understand geriatric syndromes more comprehensively.
items.limitation: 本研究为横断面设计，无法建立因果关系，且可能存在未测量混杂因素。
items.limitationEn: This study's cross-sectional design prevents establishing causality, and unmeasured confounding factors may exist.

items.title: Development of the football tactical skills scale and comparison of scores across player and training characteristics
items.summary: This study describes the development of a football tactical skills scale and compares scores across player and training characteristics.
items.curatedReason: 本研究提出了足球战术技能量表的开发和应用，为你评估运动员战术表现提供了潜在工具，但其临床转化价值仍需更多验证。
items.titleZh: 足球战术技能量表的开发及在不同球员和训练特征间的比较
items.summaryZh: 本研究描述了足球战术技能量表的开发，并比较了不同球员和训练特征间的得分。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study presents the development and application of a football tactical skills scale, offering you a potential tool for evaluating athlete tactical performance, though its clinical translation value requires further validation.
items.limitation: 本研究关注量表开发和比较，而非直接的干预效果，且为观察性研究，结论的因果推断能力有限。
items.limitationEn: This study focuses on scale development and comparison rather than direct intervention effects, and as an observational study, its causal inference capability is limited.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation
